niche: Online payment processing and financial infrastructure, providing developer-friendly APIs for businesses to accept payments, manage subscriptions/billing, and handle global money movement.
target_audience: Software developers and technical teams at startups, SaaS companies, marketplaces, and enterprises who need customizable, programmable payment infrastructure rather than off-the-shelf checkout solutions.
key_use_cases: Accepting online and in-app payments via credit cards and digital wallets
Managing recurring billing and subscription revenue for SaaS businesses
Facilitating marketplace payouts to multiple sellers or contractors
Handling cross-border payments and multi-currency transactions for global businesses
